regs_in_letter: FD&C Act misbranding (false or misleading); Form FDA-2253 submission requirement (no CFR section number cited in letter text)

cases.claim: “LUCEMYRA® IS THE ONLY FDA-APPROVED, NON OPIOID MEDICINE PROVEN TO HELP WITH SYMPTOMS OF OPIOID WITHDRAWAL.”
cases.context: Other FDA-approved lofexidine products exist for the same indication.
cases.check: Rule: flag 'the only' / 'first and only' / 'only FDA-approved' claims for mandatory verification against current approvals (incl. generics).

cases.cat: Lack of fair balance (risk presentation prominence)
cases.claim: “Demonstrated safety profile in studies” | “Lofexidine should therefore be the preferred choice for withdrawal management in an outpatient setting, where monitoring of blood pressure and management of hypotension is more difficult”
cases.context: Risk info only under collapsed header 'Click to see full Important Safety Information & Prescribing Information'; requires manual click to expand.
cases.rationale: Benefit claims prominent while risk info is hidden behind an expandable header, minimizing risk.
cases.check: Rule: on webpages, flag when ISI/risk content is only in a collapsed/expandable element or behind a click while benefit claims are visible.

cases.cat: Failure to submit at time of initial dissemination (Form FDA 2253)
cases.claim: A copy of the webpage was not submitted to FDA under cover of Form FDA-2253 at the time of initial publication as required.
cases.rationale: Promotional materials must be submitted at first use with Form FDA-2253 and current labeling.
cases.reg: Form FDA-2253 submission requirement (21 CFR 314.81(b)(3)(i) per other OPDP letters; not numerically cited here)
cases.check: Rule: before release, confirm a Form FDA 2253 submission record exists for the piece.
